proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9321 gives Prakrit bollaï, Hindi bolnā, Old Marwari bolaï and Gujarati bolvũ. Only simple inflections of bol- are grouped (both members in selected Nimadi pairs); the remote origin of *bōll is debated in the article and is not asserted here.
